blocks.text: “Pinoy Big Brother” housemate Gehlee Dangca sent “JeoLee” fans gushing after she wrote a song inspired by fellow housemate Jeo Ong and the friendship bracelet that he gave her. However, Dangca said in a recent episode of the reality show that she had yet to finish the track. She also sang a few lines in front of her fellow housemates. “I’d tell God about you / I’d tie strings in a loop… If I’m the one that you choose / Friendship bracelet for you,” a part of the song goes.
